item.title: Magical ☆ Dears
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Navel honeybell
  • 発売日: 2015-11-27
  • スコア: 6.709999999999999/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マジカル☆ディアーズ
  • 英語名: Magical ☆ Dears

あらすじ

Magician has always existed since ancient time. They never showed their true face to the public, but they are there bringing balance to the world and its history behind the shadow. However, with technology becoming more advanced and conflicts becoming more often, the magicians have no choice but to reveal themselves.

It was shown that it was futile to oppose them, and magicians were viewed with disdain from the public. However, they showed that their power could bring fortune to people, and with a help from a certain incident, people began showing their support for them. Small areas for the magician to live was estabilished across the world. One of them is in Japan, and there stand a magic school called Arcadia 5.

  • スコア: 7.32/10 (55 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 空飛ぶ羊と真夏の花 -When girls wish upon a star.-
  • 英語名: Sora Tobu Hitsuji to Manatsu no Hana -When Girls Wish Upon A Star.-

别名

  • Sorahana

あらすじ

This is the first title by Navel honeybell. Keisuke became an orphan at a young age and he was taken in by the Konohanamiya family. After overcoming strict training, he returned to Japan this summer to serve as a butler to their daughter Kotoya, who was also his osananajimi. He enrolled in the same school as her, Meisei Gakuen, and reunited with an old friend Mea. It seemed like everything would be smooth sailing, but then he received what appeared to be a love letter. Heading to the rendez-vous place, he met a young girl named Merriel who told him that he was a God who had been reborn as a human in order to find his imouto goddess on Earth.
